attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **He is not the corpus's Neon, companion of Mark the Shepherd**, who is kept with that company on another day; this entry stands alone, with no companion named, and the slug carries the day because the page gives nothing else to tell him apart by. The whole life is one sentence and carries no year, so the folder has no `dates`. No hymn is printed for him, only the distich «Eρυθρόν ημίν η Γραφή πόντον λέγει, Kαι γην ερυθράν εκτελεί τμηθείς Nέων.»
